title: Book Two · Chapter 137: The Returned Ruler
story:
Jun returns the ruler on Monday afternoon. Ronan is at the kitchen door with a bowl of peas.

“You said Monday,” Ronan says.

“It is Monday.”

“I know.”

Jun holds out the ruler. A small piece of paper is folded around it.

“The edge is clean. I used it with pencil.”

Ronan takes it. Jun looks at the peas.

“Are those your lunch?”

“Supper. If I finish before tomorrow.”

Jun sits on the step. Ronan gives him an empty bowl. They open the pods and drop the peas inside. Soon green shells make a little hill between them.

“My brother liked the wheel book,” Jun says.

“Good.”

“He made a cart from a box. It has three wheels.”

“Only three?”

“One fell off.”

Ronan smiles. Jun holds a pod like a little cart. It falls on its side.

“Like that.”

They laugh. Ronan wants to ask Jun about the next school year. For a while, he does not ask.

Mum comes to the doorway.

“Thank you, Jun. Are you staying for a little food?”

“I need to go home soon.”

She gives him a small bowl of cooked beans from lunch. He eats them while Ronan finishes the peas.

Ronan finally asks, “Will you go to Miss Wu's activity next term?”

“Yes. On one afternoon at least.”

“I will go too.”

Jun nods.

“Maybe we could—”

“Ronan.”

He stops. Jun puts the empty bowl on the step.

“I like coming here. I like the ball games. I am still choosing my school work myself.”

Ronan looks at the little hill of shells.

“I was going to ask about a book.”

“Then ask about the book.”

Ronan cannot name a book he wants to ask about. He picks up a pea from the floor instead.

“No. I was asking about a pair.”

Jun stands.

“Not yet.”

“All right.”

The answer is hard, but it is not a shouted answer. Jun thanks Mum for the beans. He leaves by the main gate.

Ronan picks up the bowls. Mum takes the shells for the rubbish. She carries them away and leaves Ronan beside the step.

“He helped with half,” Ronan says.

“Nearly,” Mum says. “You ate several.”

He looks at the remaining peas. “A small payment.”

Mum gives him the bowl to rinse. Jun has returned the ruler on the agreed day. It lies safely on the shelf. Ronan dries his hands before he puts it away. He puts it beside his pencils. Then he goes back to help Mum with the peas.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pea＝豌豆；pod＝豆荚；shell＝壳；rinse＝冲洗。

## 理解问题

1. Jun怎样说明普通来往与学校搭档不同？
2. Ronan差点用什么假话掩饰本来想问的事？

## 读句子

**Jun / puts the empty bowl / on the step.** Jun／把空碗／放在台阶上。
